title: Act: Author the boy sheet frames in boy.ts
summary: Create pure frame builders for 14 boy frames
description: Create game/frontend/src/art/boy.ts with a pure boyFrame function and BOY_SHEET_SOURCE using draw.ts helpers.
acceptance_criteria: boy.ts exports BOY_SHEET_SOURCE with 14 frames of 32x48
definition_of_done: BOY_SHEET_SOURCE exported and builds without throwing

steps.action: Create the file. Import createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex and type Grid from './draw', and type ArtSource from './sources'. Export const BOY_W = 32 and BOY_H = 48. Add boyFrame(pose: {legShift: number; armShift: number; bob: number}): Grid that makes createGrid(32,48,0), draws head (parchment 3-4 shade, rows 4+bob..), hoodie body with shadeRect('hoodie',4,2), arms offset by armShift, two legs offset by +/-legShift with indigo 2, then outlineRect around head and body using OUTLINE = rampIndex('indigo',1).
steps.code:
const OUTLINE = rampIndex('indigo', 1);
export function boyFrame(p:{legShift:number;armShift:number;bob:number}): Grid { const g = createGrid(BOY_W, BOY_H, 0); /* head, hoodie, arms, legs, outlines */ return g; }

steps.action: Add three const arrays of pose objects: IDLE_POSES length 4 (bob values 0,1,0,-1 with legShift 0), WALK_POSES length 6 (legShift -3,-2,0,3,2,0 alternating, bob 0,1,0,0,1,0), INTERACT_POSES length 4 (armShift 0,2,4,2 with legShift 0).
Export const BOY_SHEET_SOURCE: ArtSource with id 'character:boy-sheet', path 'worlds/the-boys-room/characters/boy-sheet.png', frames [...IDLE_POSES, ...WALK_POSES, ...INTERACT_POSES].map(boyFrame).
